caption: A feather is dropped in front of a running box fan and is carried away by the airflow before drifting to the floor.

sa.check: A feather is dropped in front of it.
The feather is carried away by the airflow.
The drop comes first, then the carry, then the landing.

pc.expect: The feather moves away from the fan, tumbling, and lands some distance off.
pc.fail: It falls straight down in front of the fan; or moves toward the fan; or shoots off fast like a dart.

pc.expect: It sinks as it drifts and reaches the floor.
pc.fail: It rises indefinitely; or hangs still; or drops like a stone.

pc.expect: The feather moves with the airflow only.
pc.fail: It changes direction sharply with the fan steady; or moves before it is released; or hangs motionless in the airflow.

pc.expect: The feather is light and flutters and spins.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or folds like cloth; or splits.

pc.expect: One feather and one fan keep their number.
pc.fail: The feather duplicates; or vanishes in the air; or the fan turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The feather's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The feather changes colour; or the fan changes; or the room rearranges.
